hunks.baseline: *If I calculated the past two years as a percentage, what would it be?*
hunks.sol: *If I put the odds of everything that’s happened over the past two years into percentages, what would they be?*

hunks.baseline: What were the odds that an F-rank Hunter, trudging up a hill after getting fired from his Guild, would find an old capsule discarded at a recycling station?
hunks.sol: What were the odds that an F-rank Hunter, trudging uphill after being fired from his Guild, would find an old capsule abandoned at a recycling station?

hunks.baseline: What were the odds that the old capsule would be a passage connecting to another world?
hunks.sol: What were the odds that the capsule would turn out to be a passage to another world?

hunks.baseline: What were the odds that I would begin a second life as the Third Young Master of a frontier martial family, rather than as a member of the Nangong Family or the direct Disciple of Huashan?
hunks.sol: What were the odds that I would begin my second life as the Third Young Master of a frontier martial family—not as a member of the Nangong Family or a direct Disciple of Huashan?

hunks.baseline: And after crossing one war, two massacres, and more death lines than I could count, what were the odds that I would still be alive now…?
hunks.sol: What were the odds that I would survive one war, two bloody massacres, and more brushes with death than I could count…?

hunks.baseline: After considering all of that, only one conclusion emerged.
hunks.sol: After considering all of that, I reached a single conclusion.

hunks.baseline: “Ten percent is enough after all.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. Ten percent is plenty.”

hunks.baseline: With that quiet mutter, I reached out.
hunks.sol: With that quiet murmur, I reached out.

hunks.baseline: Three jiazi of internal energy pulled Team Leader Choi and Shao Shen toward me. The Death Knights and monsters tried to move, but stopped when their leader raised a hand.
hunks.sol: Three jiazi of internal energy pulled Team Leader Choi and Shao Shen toward me. The Death Knights and monsters started to move, but stopped when their leader raised a hand.

hunks.baseline: Ignoring them, I checked the two men’s condition. Their breaths were faint, and their qi was so precarious it seemed ready to vanish at any moment.
hunks.sol: Ignoring them, I checked the two men’s condition. Their breathing was faint, and their qi was so precarious it seemed ready to vanish at any moment.

hunks.baseline: If I had taken a jet instead of teleporting, I might have been too late forever.
hunks.sol: If I had taken a jet instead of teleporting, I might have been too late.

hunks.baseline: “I would have tried even with a one-percent chance. I’m not someone who’s going to die this pointlessly.”
hunks.sol: “I would’ve tried even with a one-percent chance. I’m not the kind of guy who dies for nothing.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, I had insurance prepared in case something like this happened. I never expected to use that insurance so soon, or in a situation like this.
hunks.sol: Of course, I had also taken out some insurance in case the worst happened. I just hadn’t expected to use it so soon, let alone under circumstances like these.

hunks.baseline: The leader watched me immediately take the necessary item from my Inventory, then asked in a flat voice,
hunks.sol: The leader saw me pull the item I needed from my Inventory and asked in a flat voice,

hunks.baseline: *Shut your fucking trap.*
hunks.sol: *Shut your fucking mouth.*

hunks.baseline: I swallowed the words hovering at the tip of my tongue. Normally, that would have been quite difficult, but it was not so hard for me now.
hunks.sol: I swallowed the words hovering on the tip of my tongue. Normally, that would have been quite difficult, but right now, it wasn’t.

hunks.baseline: I did not want anyone to interfere with me. At least not right now.
hunks.sol: I didn’t want anyone interfering with me. Not now.

hunks.baseline: When I removed the magically sealed stopper, a faint fragrance escaped. A milky liquid sloshed inside the transparent glass bottle.
hunks.sol: When I removed the magically sealed stopper, a faint fragrance drifted out. Milky liquid sloshed inside the clear glass bottle.

hunks.baseline: At least right now, I had no interest in the rarity or value of this small amount of liquid—barely a hundred milliliters.
hunks.sol: Right now, I couldn’t have cared less about the rarity or value of the scant hundred milliliters in that bottle.

hunks.baseline: I simply felt grateful for Wu Heixing’s immense wealth and stupidity as I let the top-grade potion trickle between the lips of the patient lying there as if dead.
hunks.sol: I simply thanked Wu Heixing for being both fabulously wealthy and incredibly stupid, then let the potion trickle between the lips of the patient lying there like a corpse.

hunks.baseline: *Bear with it a little, Shen.*
hunks.sol: *Hang on a little longer, Shen.*

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi came first. Not only because of the time we had spent together, but even if we had shared no bond until now, I would still have chosen him first.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi came first. Partly because of all the time we had spent together, but even if we had shared no bond at all, I would still have chosen him first.

hunks.baseline: That was how serious Team Leader Choi’s injuries were.
hunks.sol: That was how serious his injuries were.

hunks.baseline: His left arm had been torn away from the shoulder. His right ankle was mangled as if something had chewed and swallowed it, while his left leg had been cleanly amputated. Seven ribs were broken, and his spine was fractured.
hunks.sol: His left arm had been torn off at the shoulder. His right ankle was mangled as though something had chewed on it, and his left leg had been cleanly severed. Seven ribs were broken, and so was his spine.

hunks.baseline: His right hand was still twisted at an unnatural angle, yet it continued to grip the hilt of his sword.
hunks.sol: His right hand, twisted at an unnatural angle, still clutched the hilt of his sword.

hunks.baseline: The leather strap he had fastened tightly so he would never lose hold of it was soaked through with blood.
hunks.sol: The leather strap he had fastened tightly around it so he wouldn’t lose his grip was soaked through with blood.

hunks.baseline: I silently undid the strap. I pulled the sword from his right hand, whose bones had been crushed, and set it beside him.
hunks.sol: I silently undid the strap, pried the sword from his crushed hand, and set it beside him.

hunks.baseline: I did not forget to offer him a reproach in my heart.
hunks.sol: I didn’t forget to scold him in my head.

hunks.baseline: And then a genuine miracle began.
hunks.sol: Then the real miracle began.

hunks.baseline: When I carefully tilted the bottle and administered exactly half of it, a sound like something burning filled the air, and the wounds covering Team Leader Choi’s entire body began to heal.
hunks.sol: I carefully tilted the bottle and poured exactly half of it into his mouth. With a sound like flesh searing, the wounds covering Team Leader Choi’s body began to heal.

hunks.baseline: Hissssss, hissssss—
hunks.sol: Hissssss. Hissssss—

hunks.baseline: His bones grew back, severed muscles reconnected, and his organs and flesh closed together.
hunks.sol: Bones regrew, severed muscles rejoined, and damaged organs and flesh knitted together.

hunks.baseline: His recovery was even faster than a Troll’s, the very embodiment of regeneration. As Team Leader Choi’s body recovered as if time were being reversed, color finally returned to his face.
hunks.sol: He recovered even faster than a Troll, the very embodiment of regeneration. As if time itself had been reversed, color finally began returning to Team Leader Choi’s face.

hunks.baseline: *His qi is stable, too. This is enough.*
hunks.sol: *His qi has stabilized too. This should be enough.*

hunks.baseline: The result was more than satisfactory to me.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t have asked for a better result.

hunks.baseline: It was not satisfactory to someone else watching the scene.
hunks.sol: The others watching, however, were far less pleased.

hunks.baseline: —Stop immediately.
hunks.sol: —Stop at once.

hunks.baseline: —They have been given the destiny—
hunks.sol: —They have been granted the destiny—

hunks.baseline: —of becoming subservient to our mighty Lord.
hunks.sol: —of serving our mighty Lord.

hunks.baseline: I silently looked at the two Death Knights who stepped forward in place of their leader.
hunks.sol: I silently regarded the two Death Knights who stepped forward in place of their leader.

hunks.baseline: Their bodies were covered in pitch-black armor, and at a glance they looked like twins. They were similar in height, and their voices were difficult to distinguish.
hunks.sol: Clad from head to toe in pitch-black armor, they looked almost like twins. They were roughly the same height, and even their voices were difficult to tell apart.

hunks.baseline: There was only one obvious difference between them: the weapons hanging at their waists were different.
hunks.sol: There was only one obvious difference between them: the weapons at their waists.

hunks.baseline: That was already enough to provide an answer. I had solved the question, so I could write down the answer later. Right now, it was time to solve the remaining problem.
hunks.sol: That was enough to give me my answer. I had solved the question; I could write down the answer later.
Right now, I had another problem to deal with.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve had a rough time too, Shen.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve been through hell too, Shen.”

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen was not as severely injured as Team Leader Choi, but he had still suffered serious wounds. I was just about to pour the remaining half of the potion into his mouth when—
hunks.sol: Shao Shen wasn’t as badly injured as Team Leader Choi, but his wounds were still severe. I was about to pour the remaining half of the potion into his mouth when—

hunks.baseline: —Put down those two humans, withdraw, and beg for mercy.
hunks.sol: —Put down those two humans, step back, and beg for mercy.

hunks.baseline: —Then our Lord will take you in as a servant.
hunks.sol: —Then our Lord will take you as his servant.

hunks.baseline: —That is correct.
hunks.sol: —Yes.

hunks.baseline: Along with the emotionless, flat voice, one of the Death Knights stepped toward me. The scabbard fixed to his waist swayed with every step.
hunks.sol: One of the Death Knights stepped toward me, its voice flat and emotionless. The scabbard secured at its waist swayed with every step.

hunks.baseline: One step. Two steps. Three steps.
hunks.sol: One step. Two steps. Three.

hunks.baseline: There was not even a hint of hesitation in the creature approaching me.
hunks.sol: There wasn’t a trace of hesitation in its approach.

hunks.baseline: The Death Knight spoke in a confident tone so strong that it was hard to believe he was an undead monster without emotions.
hunks.sol: The Death Knight spoke with such confidence that it was hard to believe it was an emotionless undead monster.

hunks.baseline: Without even raising my head, I continued pouring in the potion.
hunks.sol: Without even raising my head, I continued pouring the potion.

hunks.baseline: After emptying the last few drops into Shao Shen’s mouth, I closed the bottle and put it back in my Inventory.
hunks.sol: Once the last few drops had fallen into Shao Shen’s mouth, I stoppered the empty bottle and returned it to my Inventory.

hunks.baseline: Hissssss, hissssss.
hunks.sol: Hissssss. Hissssss—

hunks.baseline: A signal that recovery had begun.
hunks.sol: The sound of his recovery beginning.

hunks.baseline: I straightened up at the welcome sound I had been waiting for. Looking at the Death Knight, I said what I had wanted to say for some time.
hunks.sol: I straightened at the welcome sound I had been waiting for, looked at the Death Knight, and finally said what I’d been wanting to say.

hunks.baseline: “Team Leader Choi’s left leg. It was empty from a handspan below the knee. Completely clean. Shao Shen—the young one’s was his right arm.”
hunks.sol: “Team Leader Choi’s left leg. Everything below a point one handspan beneath the knee was gone. Cut off clean. And Shao Shen—that young kid lost his right arm.”

hunks.baseline: I gave him a faint smile.
hunks.sol: I gave it a faint smile.

hunks.baseline: “If you cut off limbs that were perfectly attached, you should be prepared for the consequences.”
hunks.sol: “If you cut off perfectly good limbs, you should’ve been prepared for what came next.”

hunks.baseline: And then, in the next moment—
hunks.sol: And in the next instant—

hunks.baseline: Time was split in half, then split again within that divided instant, and before I knew it, the creature had arrived right in front of my nose.
hunks.sol: In the sliver of time left after an instant had been split in half, then split again, the creature was suddenly right in front of me.

hunks.baseline: It was the opposite.
hunks.sol: It was the other way around.

hunks.baseline: It had not come to me.
hunks.sol: It hadn’t come to me.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s see that vaunted skill of yours.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s see how good you really are.”

hunks.baseline: Everything happened in an instant. The Death Knight tried to draw his sword, and I reached out with my left hand and pressed down firmly on the back of his hand.
hunks.sol: Everything happened at once. The Death Knight tried to draw its sword, and I reached out with my left hand and pressed firmly against the back of its hand.
The dark blade had barely cleared its scabbard before it was forced back inside.

hunks.baseline: The dark-gray blade had barely begun to emerge before it slid back into its scabbard—but by then, my fist had already punched through the creature’s chest.
hunks.sol: By then, my fist had already punched through the creature’s chest.

hunks.baseline: The Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist, charged with the Scorching Yang Qi of three jiazi, vaporized even the fistful of blood remaining inside the undead monster and blazed up using its long-dead body as kindling.
hunks.sol: The Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist, carrying three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi, vaporized even the last traces of blood inside the undead creature and set its long-dead body ablaze like kindling.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh! KRAAAASH!
hunks.sol: Whoosh! Rooooar!

hunks.baseline: Engulfed in inextinguishable flames, the Death Knight waved its hands and turned toward its kin.
hunks.sol: Engulfed in flames that refused to die, the Death Knight flailed its arms and turned toward its kin.

hunks.baseline: It staggered along the path it had walked so confidently, then collapsed into ash.
hunks.sol: It staggered back along the path it had strode down so confidently, then crumbled into ash.

hunks.baseline: Even with thousands of monsters gathered together, the silence was absolute, as if someone had pressed a mute button.
hunks.sol: Though thousands of monsters were gathered there, everything went silent as if someone had pressed a mute button.

hunks.baseline: I took White Flame from my Inventory and began walking slowly.
hunks.sol: I took White Flame from my Inventory and slowly began to walk.

hunks.baseline: Everywhere my gaze fell, and everywhere my feet stepped, there were corpses and blood.
hunks.sol: Everywhere I looked and everywhere I stepped, there were corpses and blood.

hunks.baseline: Countless rifles kept catching against my feet, while a soldier wearing a crooked helmet stared up at the sky with eyes from which life had already departed.
hunks.sol: Countless rifles caught against my feet. A soldier in a crooked combat helmet stared at the sky with lifeless eyes.

hunks.baseline: At least that soldier’s corpse was still intact.
hunks.sol: At least his corpse was still intact.

hunks.baseline: In what appeared to have been the fiercest battlefield, people who seemed to be Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department lay dead in mangled conditions.
hunks.sol: In what appeared to have been the fiercest part of the battlefield, Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department lay dead, their bodies mangled beyond recognition.

hunks.baseline: I had spent a full week with the 1st Regiment led by Shao Shen. Among the corpses were many familiar faces.
hunks.sol: I had spent a full week with the 1st Regiment under Shao Shen. Among the corpses were several faces I recognized.

hunks.baseline: *So many people died. So many.*
hunks.sol: *So many died. So damn many.*

hunks.baseline: At least three thousand humans had died here today alone.
hunks.sol: Nearly three thousand people had died here today alone.

hunks.baseline: If all five fronts were combined, and the civilians killed in this monster wave were included, how many victims would there be?
hunks.sol: How many would that number become if I added the dead from all five fronts? If I included the civilians killed in this monster wave?

hunks.baseline: I borrowed the spear of an unknown Hunter and drove it deep into the ground. The leather strap belonging to Team Leader Choi, tied securely to the end of the shaft, fluttered in the wind.
hunks.sol: I borrowed an unknown Hunter’s spear and drove it deep into the ground. Team Leader Choi’s leather strap, tied securely to the end of the shaft, fluttered in the wind.

hunks.baseline: Death Knight Lord. What an imposing name.
hunks.sol: Death Knight Lord.

hunks.baseline: It was also a monster with enough power to match that grand name.
hunks.sol: What a grand name. Then again, the monster possessed enough power to live up to it.

hunks.baseline: *The circumstances are different, but there is another one like him.*
hunks.sol: *The circumstances are different, but I do have another one like him.*

hunks.baseline: I called out to the one who had maintained the longest silence in history.
hunks.sol: I called out to the creature currently setting a new record for silence.

hunks.baseline: “Let me ask you for one favor.”
hunks.sol: “Let me ask you a favor.”

hunks.baseline: I thought he might pretend not to hear me, but after a brief hesitation, the Skeleton Warlord answered.
hunks.sol: I expected him to pretend he hadn’t heard, but after a brief hesitation, the Skeleton Warlord answered.

hunks.baseline: —……A favor? You’re not asking me to fight alongside you, are you?
hunks.sol: —……A favor? You’re not asking me to fight beside you, are you?

hunks.baseline: I had never expected that, nor did I expect it now. The favor I wanted to ask had nothing to do with fighting.
hunks.sol: I had never expected that of him, and I didn’t now. The favor I wanted had nothing to do with fighting.

hunks.baseline: With my permission, the Skeleton Warlord had been absorbing death qi whenever there was an opportunity, and had consequently grown stronger.
hunks.sol: With my permission, the Skeleton Warlord had been absorbing death qi whenever possible, growing stronger in the process.

hunks.baseline: As a Named Monster, it should have been able to handle several ordinary A-rank monsters by itself.
hunks.sol: As a Named Monster, he should have been capable of handling several ordinary A-rank monsters by himself.

hunks.baseline: “When the battle is over, I’ll grant you any wish.”
hunks.sol: “When this battle is over, I’ll grant you any wish.”

hunks.baseline: —In that case, there’s nothing I can’t do. But how long am I supposed to protect them?
hunks.sol: —In that case, I suppose I can do it. But how long must I protect them?

hunks.baseline: “That should be obvious…”
hunks.sol: “That’s obvious…”

hunks.baseline: I raised White Flame and aimed it at the Death Knight Lord.
hunks.sol: I raised White Flame and pointed it at the Death Knight Lord.

hunks.baseline: —You insane—
hunks.sol: —You lunatic…!

hunks.baseline: “You’re too late.”
hunks.sol: “Too late.”

hunks.baseline: I pulled the Skeleton Warlord’s skull from my Inventory and threw it behind me.
hunks.sol: I pulled the Skeleton Warlord’s skull from my Inventory and tossed it behind me.

hunks.baseline: While it hurriedly regenerated its body, I stroked the leather strap fluttering from the spear shaft.
hunks.sol: As he hurriedly regenerated his body, I stroked the leather strap fluttering from the spear shaft.

hunks.baseline: How had he—how had they—felt?
hunks.sol: How had he felt?
How had they all felt?

hunks.baseline: What had they been thinking as they charged toward death? I could not even begin to guess.
hunks.sol: What had gone through their minds as they charged toward their deaths?
I couldn’t begin to imagine.

hunks.baseline: There was only one thing I could be certain of now.
hunks.sol: There was only one thing I knew for certain.

hunks.baseline: “Any bastard who comes past this spear is going to fucking die.”
hunks.sol: “Any bastard who crosses this spear is fucking dead.”

hunks.baseline: Flesh and bone shattered and flew in every direction.
hunks.sol: Flesh and bone shattered, spraying in every direction.

hunks.baseline: An ogre’s limbs were sent flying, while a Troll was engulfed in inextinguishable flames before it had a chance to regenerate.
hunks.sol: An ogre’s limbs went flying, while a Troll was engulfed in unquenchable flames before it had a chance to regenerate.

hunks.baseline: The head of a Lycanthrope that had bared its fangs exploded.
hunks.sol: The head of a Lycanthrope baring its fangs exploded.

hunks.baseline: A Dullahan came charging at me, covered in foul-smelling brain matter, only to be cleaved in two with a single blow. The halberd, having found a new master, flew away with tremendous force and tore through a Wyvern’s wing.
hunks.sol: A Dullahan charged through the spray of foul-smelling brain matter, only to be cleaved in half with a single blow. Its halberd found a new master and shot away with tremendous force, tearing through a Wyvern’s wing.

hunks.baseline: CRACKLE!
hunks.sol: CRACK!

hunks.baseline: A rain of blood scattered through the air.
hunks.sol: Blood rained from the sky.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a streak of blue flame came flying through the rain.
hunks.sol: At the same moment, a streak of blue flame cut through the downpour.

hunks.baseline: A storm of blood erupted. Whenever the flames embroidered the air, dozens of monsters fell and hundreds of monsters stepped backward.
hunks.sol: A storm of blood erupted. Whenever the flames streaked through the air, dozens of monsters fell and hundreds recoiled.

hunks.baseline: They were afraid of the death line carved by a single human with a single spear.
hunks.sol: They had grown afraid of a single human—and of the line of death he had drawn with a single spear.

hunks.baseline: The flat voice of the Death Knight, which had never wavered, now contained tremors and inflection.
hunks.sol: For the first time, the Death Knight’s flat, unwavering voice trembled with emotion.

hunks.baseline: The black knight knew perfectly well what his subordinate’s desperate call meant.
hunks.sol: The black knight knew perfectly well what his subordinate’s desperate plea meant.

hunks.baseline: Between the slits of the deeply lowered helmet, red eyes flickered.
hunks.sol: Red light flickered beneath his deeply lowered helmet.

hunks.baseline: As he advanced, leaking immense magical power, he tried to ignore the strange words and scenes that kept surfacing in his mind.
hunks.sol: As he advanced, immense magical power rolling off him, he tried to ignore the strange words and scenes that kept surfacing in his mind.

hunks.baseline: Nothing could take precedence over his creator, his eternal lord.
hunks.sol: Nothing could take precedence over his creator, his eternal sovereign.

hunks.baseline: At the voice of his lord echoing like a hallucination, the black knight quietly replied,
hunks.sol: At his lord’s voice echoing like a hallucination, the black knight quietly replied,

hunks.baseline: He failed to realize it until the very end.
hunks.sol: Until the very end, he failed to realize one thing.

hunks.baseline: That his hand was groping somewhere between the plates of his armor.
hunks.sol: His hand was searching between the plates of his armor.
